attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as router for the private network shared with node2/node3: fixed static IP 192.168.50.1/24 on eth1 (new 'priv' UCI interface), a dnsmasq DHCP pool serving node2 (192.168.50.188) and node3 (192.168.50.175), and a firewall rule rejecting inbound TCP/23 from that network. Verified all settings functioned, then restarted all three nodes one at a time (node1 first, since it is the router under test, then node2, then node3), proving each node's boot_id changed and that the fixed IP, DHCP service, and TCP/23 REJECT rule were all still configured and actively serving traffic afterward.
